viv (AE): Polaris Health sent an RFI this morning. Key asks: POC acceptance criteria, monthly reserved pricing, overage rates, KMS/HSM compatibility, and a short security questionnaire. Can we assemble answers and a capability matrix?
jia (SE): Ill draft the POC runbook and perf targets. They listed ~150 qps gen and 2k embeddings/min. Suggest 10-business-day pilot: embed p95 < 300ms, gen end-to-end p95 < 600ms, error rate < 0.5%.
lucas (Solutions Eng): For sustained 150 qps recommend Dedicated with autoscale and 1.5x headroom. Pricing ballpark: $12k-$20k/month depending on region/term. Pilot discount: 25% off low end. Overage suggestion: $0.11 per gen-token-equivalent; $0.0010 per embed.
ovar (typo noted):
omar (Security Eng): Quick KMS/HSM copy for RFI: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments via KMIP-compatible HSMs and major cloud KMS providers. Hosted API supports envelope BYOK integrations with partner HSMs. Key usage events and audit logs available on request." Also add: "SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports available under NDA; annual third-party penetration tests."
jia (SE): Preflight checklist for their infra team: 
- Allow outbound 443 to <region>.api.redwood.ai
- Run healthcheck: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- TLS verify: openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
- Optional: provide static egress IPs for firewall whitelisting
Ill paste that into the RFI.
viv (AE): Capability matrix rows needed: Data residency, KMS/HSM, Observability (per-route latency & token counts), Rollout & Failover, Quantization support. Keep rows one-line each.
lucas (Solutions Eng): Draft one-liners: 
- Data residency: "Region-restricted hosted deployments in NA/EU; Private/on-prem for full data locality"
- KMS/HSM: "BYOK via Cloud KMS or KMIP HSMs; key usage audit events"
- Observability: "Per-route latency histograms, token accounting, exportable CSVs and read-only dashboards"
- Rollout & Failover: "Canary rollouts and auto-fallback to compatible hosted model variants on Dedicated outage"
- Quantization: "INT8/4-bit inference supported on Dedicated via optimized runtime"
viv (AE): Contracts asked about refundable trial deposit. Standard practice: one-month reserved fee held as deposit, refundable if pilot acceptance criteria met. Add to commercial sheet.
contracts-bot: DPA and SOW templates uploaded to shared Drive folder.
viv (AE): Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/polaris-rfi/ (cap matrix, DPA, SOW draft). Action items: jia = runbook & preflight; lucas = pricing band + capmatrix edits; omar = security copy + questionnaire answers; viv = assemble final RFI and send to Legal. rfi-bot: RFI logged and assigned to viv (AE) 1 due 2026-04-08.
viv (AE): Thanks team 44D Ill post the compiled packet here when ready.
